definition: A set of test cases designed to measure an LLM application's performance against clearly defined success criteria.
whyItMatters: Be task-specific (mirror the real task distribution, include edge cases), automate grading when possible, and prioritize volume over hand-graded quality.
example: Grade sentiment labels by exact match; use LLM-based grading on a Likert scale for tone.

source.title: Define success criteria and build evaluations

definition: Code-based (fastest, most reliable, but lacks nuance), human (most flexible, but slow and expensive) and LLM-based (fast, flexible, suits complex judgment).
whyItMatters: Use the fastest, most reliable, most scalable method. Avoid human grading if possible; test LLM graders' reliability first.
example: Exact match: `output == golden_answer`. String match: `key_phrase in output`.

source.title: Define success criteria and build evaluations

definition: Re-sending a request that came back with `stop_reason: "refusal"` to another Claude model, which can usually still answer it.
whyItMatters: Re-sending to the same model usually earns another refusal. On the Claude API, server-side fallback (beta) retries within a single call.
example: Set `"fallbacks": "default"` to retry on the model Anthropic recommends for the refusal category.

definition: A 400 `invalid_request_error` returned when `thinking` blocks in the latest assistant message were edited, reordered, filtered out or reconstructed.
whyItMatters: The fix is in your request: with tool use, pass every `thinking` and `redacted_thinking` block back exactly as received, including empty ones.
example: If you filter content blocks by type before resending, keep both `thinking` and `redacted_thinking`.

definition: Unicode and forward-slash escaping in tool inputs differs between model versions (Opus 4.6+), so raw string comparisons can start failing with newer models.
whyItMatters: Parse tool inputs with `json.loads()` or `JSON.parse()` and compare values. Never do raw string matching on serialized input.

definition: The Agent SDK can export metrics, log events and traces (beta) over OTLP. It's off until you set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1` and choose an exporter.
whyItMatters: Telemetry is structural by default: prompt and tool content are opt-in. Export errors fail silently unless you set `CLAUDE_CODE_OTEL_DIAG_STDERR=1`.
